reviews_captured_by_me.text:
They have just retrofitted my cabinet for a new range top I am installing. These guys are professionals that I would trust with my eyes closed. They got all the specs before they gave me the quote. Jim and Chuck, guys who did the actual work are the nicest people you'll find - professional, polite and patient. They made sure all the jars, that I had in the drawers before fit perfectly after the job was done and they did all the minute adjustments needed. I would highly recommend them.
I did more work with them later to add a custom panel to my new dishwasher. Quality of their workmanship and service is as great as before.They always go the extra mile to meet your needs. I would highly, highly recommend them.

I simply cannot rave more about Uxbridge Cabinet Center!
They captured our vision perfectly and more!  Their product and workmanship is second to none and their years of experience speaks for itself.  They epitomize professionalism.  A big shout out to JIM for the amazing installation and personable customer service.  We LOVE our kitchen and our newest custom built-ins project.  5 stars !!!

UXBRIDGE Cabinets did such a beautiful job creating an amazing kitchen for us! They were so thorough, helpful and wonderful to work with. It was so seamless that we were able to not only have our kitchen designed but they also cut and installed our quartz countertops. One stop for all our needs. The installation was fast and well done.  They delivered everything that they had promised. I couldn’t recommend them enough.
